evidence: compute_delta_pdf defaulted to apodization "hann" and gaussian_sigma 0.5 (src/nebula3d/analysis/delta_pdf.py:387-388, and _prepare_forward at :560-561), while the pipeline's ΔPDF stage runs DeltaPdfParams' "gaussian" and 0.4 (src/nebula3d/pipeline.py:621-622), so a call with no window transformed differently from the stage. The ring texture order is 8 on the page (web/src/state/pipelineStore.ts:156, web/src/llm/tune/catalog.ts:149-157) and 6 in the package (src/nebula3d/_ringplane.py:63), with nothing saying why.
proposed_fix: compute_delta_pdf and _prepare_forward default to the pipeline's window, gaussian 0.4, as a behaviour change of the Python API; a test pins every keyword they share with DeltaPdfParams. The ring texture order stays 8 on the page and 6 in the package, each with a comment, and a test pins both: it applies only to the patched and parametric ring models, not the default pooled one, and changing either would change runs on that path.
note: Approved by the manager on the user's delegation, 2026-10-19 (plan 4.12, the defaults). Every caller in the package passes its own window, so the pipeline, the server, the browser and arm A are unchanged: arm A on dev re-run, 32 of 32 entries identical, 5 of 8 cases pass, as recorded. The dpdf_features known-answer tests, which call compute_delta_pdf with its defaults, pass under the new window. The rest of 4.12 (the consistency view on the run's settings, the native–browser parity test) is still to come.

decision.by: the manager, on the user's delegation
decision.option: the function takes the pipeline's window; the ring order stays 8 on the page and 6 in the package, with a comment
